name: Slippery Skin

card.plain: Slick kappa skin makes you impossible to throw while the move starts up.

notes: A move property the engine reads for throws. E17 as written says throws ignore throw-invulnerability data (E12), with no exception, which would make this modifier do nothing; the GDD modifier table ('Throw-invulnerable during startup') is what is implemented and takes precedence pending a designer amendment to rules.md. Data only, no new animation (A10); visual is a preset reference for clip-matcher. Number from the rules.md modifiers table.
